svg.title: MD 03 Sensor Opinion
svg.desc: Plot titled "MD Update (Transforming the Measurement)," position X versus position Y. A large purple prediction uncertainty ellipse, tilted up and to the right, is centered near (8.2, 5). A smaller filled orange ellipse, the effective sensor belief at H inverse z sub k with covariance P sub meas, is centered near (12, 8) and only partly overlaps it. A gray line between the two centers is the residual, z sub k minus H x sub pred. The innovation covariance is S equals H P sub pred H transpose plus R.
